title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Motor Court Neon. Keep it, take the porte-cochère pick, adopt a declined challenger, or re-roll.

options.label: Motor Court Neon
options.lineage: Mid-century SoCal motel signs, pool-fence stripes, and night-into-morning motor courts
options.thesis: Scoot SoCal as a motor-court sign: the Pride scooter is already at the curb, and vacancy is the booking.
options.viewport: Portrait phone: dusk porte-cochère full-bleed, 4-wheel travel scooter at the lobby, Scoot/SoCal as the motel sign, Request dates as a lit vacancy plate, Call as the office light.
options.risk: Vintage pastiche or kick-scooter vacation brand if the Pride 4-wheel object is not the only vehicle on the page.

raised.raise: One corridor at a time: service areas as concentric rings of commitment (core vs quoted), never a fake live map.
Palette law: citrus is reserved for Call and Request dates, never scatter decoration.
One gravity: the mobile fold is one dominant photo of the scooter at the hotel, not competing motifs.
One arc: the porte-cochère curve rules the hero instead of a three-column SaaS grid.
Two inks: type is navy or citrus only; photography is the third register.
Generous void: one large photographic object in space; the selected scooter class swells.

options.label: Porte-Cochère Arrival
options.lineage: Anaheim Resort hotel valet tickets, laminated arrival sleeves, lobby drop
options.thesis: The site is the arrival: a Pride scooter already waiting under the hotel canopy, the valet ticket as the rental request.
options.viewport: Portrait phone: morning hotel canopy, scooter at the curb, laminated ticket stack as the form, Call and Request as punch-stamped actions.
options.risk: This is the direction most hotel-rental sites land on: familiar, clear, and easy to flatten into a generic hero.

options.label: Corridor Event Display
options.thesis: One booking as one frozen event: tracks through concentric service rings.
options.viewport: Concentric Anaheim/Hollywood rings, a delivery track blooming to the hotel pin.
options.risk: Families booking Disneyland do not identify with CERN.
options.case: Loses audience identification and product clarity; hotel drop is not a collision.
options.kept: One event held at a time: isolate a corridor, dim the rest.

options.label: Phosphor Cabinet
options.thesis: The rental as a 240-line stage: classes as sprite states, citrus as the power-up.
options.viewport: Integer-scaled playfield, three scooter sprites, Call as START.
options.risk: Reads as a kick-scooter game, which the brief forbids.
options.case: Loses both axes: play language fights Pride medical scooters.
options.kept: Palette law: flashing citrus reserved for the primary action.

options.label: Gravity Rain Garden
options.thesis: Deliveries fall toward hotels according to the color of each cloud.
options.viewport: Scooters raining toward a hotel canopy under a citrus cloud.
options.risk: Dream physics hides the private-pay hotel rental.
options.case: Loses both: the drop is literal, not surreal.
options.kept: One gravity field dominant on phones.

options.label: Curved Crease Shell
options.thesis: The compact travel scooter as one crease that locks into a rigid day.
options.viewport: A cream disc lifting along one citrus arc into a scooter silhouette.
options.risk: Folding explains only the light class, not the whole offer.
options.case: Loses audience; holds a fragment of product (travel breakdown) and nothing else.
options.kept: One sweeping arc as compositional law, not a rectangular card grid.

options.label: Two-Ink Zine
options.thesis: Navy and citrus printed a hair out of line, photography as the overlap.
options.viewport: Wordmark in citrus, scooter in navy, misregister making a third color.
options.risk: Indie-print youth culture, not a family booking a parent at Disneyland.
options.case: Loses both axes; overlap is pretty and proves nothing about hotel delivery.
options.kept: Two inks, imagery in one register, type in the other.

options.label: Memory Towers
options.thesis: Classes as glowing objects in a navy void; the selected scooter swells.
options.viewport: Three floating scooters in dusk void, the chosen one glowing citrus.
options.risk: Game-menu luxury fights sun-washed hospitality and the sand ground.
options.case: Loses both: adult children booking Disneyland do not glide through fog rooms.
options.kept: Generous void and a selected object that swells.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A high-craft mobility-rental landing: sticky call bar, photo hero, three class cards, pricing grid, FAQ.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft, with the brief’s navy, sand, and citrus.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from A Scooter 4 U and Scootaround by design.
